description: Source code for the Mattermost upgrader service on Linux, handling download, signature verification, binary extraction, and upgrade status management.

classes.name: writeCounter
classes.description: A counter for tracking bytes written during download, used to calculate upgrade progress percentage.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Implements io.Writer; updates progress percentage based on bytes written.

methods.name: getUpgradePercentage
methods.description: Returns the current upgrade progress percentage.

methods.name: setUpgradePercentage
methods.description: Sets the upgrade progress percentage atomically.

methods.name: getUpgradeError
methods.description: Returns the current upgrade error, thread-safe.

methods.name: getCurrentVersionTgzURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the current version's tar.gz file.

methods.name: verifySignature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of the downloaded file using OpenPGP.

methods.name: canIWriteTheExecutable
methods.description: Checks if the process has permission to write to its executable.

methods.name: canIUpgrade
methods.description: Checks if the system environment supports upgrade (architecture and OS).

methods.name: CanIUpgradeToE0
methods.description: Checks if upgrade to E0 is possible, considering current version and environment.

methods.name: UpgradeToE0
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process: download, verify, extract, and replace binary.

methods.name: UpgradeToE0Status
methods.description: Returns current upgrade progress and error status.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL, saves to a temp file, and tracks progress.

methods.name: getFilePermissionsOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves file permissions or returns default if inaccessible.

methods.name: extractBinary
methods.description: Extracts the 'mattermost' binary from a tar.gz archive and replaces the current executable.
